title.value: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Precise Soccer Shooting Skills using a Quadrupedal Robot
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the content and focus of the paper, which details a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework specifically aimed at developing precise soccer shooting skills using a quadrupedal robot.
title.quote: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Precise Soccer Shooting Skills using a Quadrupedal Robot

extractions.description: This paper presents a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework to enable quadrupedal robots to perform precise soccer shooting skills. The framework is developed to manage both robot motion control and motion planning in shooting a deformable soccer ball to random targets.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on robotics and machine learning techniques for developing soccer shooting skills in quadrupedal robots, and it does not primarily address climate or ecologically-related sustainable development issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We address the problem of enabling quadrupedal robots to perform precise shooting skills in the real world using reinforcement learning.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on developing robotics and machine learning algorithms for precise soccer skills in robots; it doesn't directly tackle any climate or ecological sustainable development category.
primary_category.quote: Our goal is to develop controllers that allow a quadrupedal robot to use one leg to shoot a ball to a specified target while standing.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not specifically relate to any listed climate or ecologically-related sustainable development sub-category as it concentrates on robotics for soccer ball shooting.
primary_sub_category.quote: Developing algorithms to enable a legged robot to shoot a soccer ball to a given target is a challenging problem that combines robot motion control and planning into one task.

new_primary_category.justification: While the paper is not directly related to sustainable development or ecological topics, it contributes to the advancement of robotics and machine learning.
new_primary_category.quote: We propose a hierarchical framework that leverages deep reinforcement learning to train (a) a robust motion control policy that can track arbitrary motions and (b) a planning policy to decide the desired kicking motion to shoot a soccer ball to a target.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper develops methodologies for control and motion planning in robotics, particularly focusing on precise shooting skills using quadrupedal robots.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: This framework leverages model-free RL to enable a standing quadrupedal robot to precisely shoot a soccer ball by coupling robot motion control and motion planning.
